notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (tier 1) worked throughout; site is Angular/Spartacus on SAP Commerce Cloud, exact counts sourced from the OCC REST API (apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search?query=:relevancy:allCategories:<slug>), reading pagination.totalResults - the same authoritative method used in the prior Home-Decor pass for this company (facet-widget numbers are not used). Sale-vs-Clearance reasoning: Fabindia's hamburger nav has a top-level 'Sale' node structurally identical to 'New Arrivals' (same depth, permanent presence, not a named seasonal campaign banner) with children All in Sale, Women, Men, Kids, Home & Living, Furniture, Personal Care, Food. Resolved the Home & Living and Furniture child links via the CMS components OCC endpoint to /shop/sale-home-living and /shop/sale-furniture respectively (excluded Women/Men/Kids=apparel, Personal Care and Food=non-decor departments). Checked page <title>/meta description/on-page SEO text of both pages plus the whole sitemap-category.xml (720KB) for the words Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line/Discontinued - zero hits anywhere on the site; both pages are literally titled 'Buy at Home & Living Sale Online' / 'Buy at Furniture Sale Online', i.e. plain 'Sale', which per the brief should NOT be auto-classified as Clearance. However, spot-checked product records returned by the sale-home-living API query and most (not all) carry the site's own 'sale': true product attribute, consistent with genuine markdowns rather than an arbitrary filter; combined with the section's permanent (non-campaign) placement in the main nav, this has clearance-like characteristics without clearance-specific wording. Treated as the brief's explicit ambiguous case: recorded both rows with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than including or excluding outright. Also found ~10 deeper per-subcategory sale-<slug> pages nested under Home & Living (e.g. sale-home-decor=90, sale-kitchen-dining=284, sale-lighting=1, sale-storage-utility=1) but reported at the department level (Home & Living / Furniture, matching the site's actual main-nav depth for this concept) rather than itemizing every leaf subcategory, to avoid re-deriving the full category catalog structure covered by other category-specific deliverables. Scope: excluded Women/Men/Kids apparel sale sections and Food/Personal Care sale sections as non-decor per task instructions.
